name: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer

fee.note: Published exam-only price; includes two exam attempts, two exam-simulator sessions and 12 months to schedule. Bundles with a course or a subscription cost more.

exam.format: Online, proctored, performance-based exam: 15–20 tasks solved at a command line running Kubernetes (v1.37 at the time of checking), in two hours. No prerequisites; working knowledge of container runtimes and microservice architecture is assumed.

access.retake: One free retake is included if the first attempt is not passed; it must be taken within the 12 months of eligibility that start at purchase, with no enforced wait beyond scoring (up to 24 hours) and the 24-hour booking lead time.
access.accommodations: Candidates with disabilities send the Test Accommodations Form at least two weeks before the exam, before scheduling it; requests are reviewed case by case.

scope: Designing, building and deploying cloud-native applications on Kubernetes, tested at the command line.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: The exam environment moves to each new Kubernetes minor version within about 4–8 weeks of its release.
Exam tasks are shown in English, Japanese or Simplified Chinese, and candidates can switch language during the exam.
Passing the CKAD also renews the KCNA automatically (Linux Foundation CARE program).

prep.title: Linux Foundation: Kubernetes for Developers (LFD259)
prep.note: Its topics are aligned with the CKAD domains; also sold in a bundle with the exam.

prep.title: Killer.sh CKAD simulator
prep.note: Two 36-hour sessions of 17 graded questions are included with the exam registration.

domains_note: Weights from the Linux Foundation certification page, 'Domains & Competencies' section, read 2026-11-17; the CNCF CKAD curriculum v1.37 PDF gives the same weights.
